name: Default
shortDescription: Open source message and streaming broker for AMQP, MQTT and STOMP, with the management web UI and HTTP API served on the app domain.

alerts.message: Log in to the management UI as admin with the generated RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS. It only seeds the first user on an empty node; later changes are made in the management UI under Admin > Users.

Only the management UI and HTTP API are routed. AMQP (5672) is TCP and is not published by this template; services in the same stack reach the broker at rabbitmq:5672. The MQTT and STOMP plugins ship with the image but are not enabled.
